findings.root_cause: Code Reviewer scope and execution did not exclude human-approval.yaml precisely enough.
findings.minimum_remediation: Create a Code exact scope that forbids human-approval.yaml and sequence B3 human approval after all reviews.

findings.root_cause: B2 task-local Security evidence used an unregistered version-2 shape instead of the registered production schema.
findings.minimum_remediation: Generate B3 Security evidence conforming to the registered production security-evidence schema and validate it through the official loader.

findings.root_cause: B2 inherited two M320 implementation planning paths into the required Security allowlist.
findings.minimum_remediation: Use exact approved M320 wrapper paths and exclude both implementation plan/handoff paths and all directory globs.

findings.root_cause: Reviewer thread lifetime/capacity was not preflighted and QA capacity was not reserved.
findings.minimum_remediation: Use a fresh B3 orchestration task with two waves and reserve one Wave-2 QA slot before Wave 1 starts.
